correctness.rationale: For all d>=0, explicit Euclidean expansion gives Z=d cos t+sin t cos s. Conditional-on-s arcsine density and its exact angular average yield K(1/A)/sqrt(A) for A>1 and K(A) for 0<A<1 via sine substitution. Both sides of caustics follow K(1-eta)=log(4/sqrt(eta))+O(eta log(1/eta)); uniform crossover away from lambda=±1 follows eta=d²|1-lambda²|(1+O(d²)). Change of variables and trigonometric moments are exact. Replayed checker.py passed 61 independent numerical diagnostics; computations are supplemental, not infinite proof.
